title: Drumpad
description: An interactive online drumpad that allows you to play various drum sounds using your keyboard or mouse. Perfect for music enthusiasts and aspiring drummers.
imageAlt: Interactive drumpad interface with square pads

title: GPS Viewer
description: A real-time GPS tracking application that displays your current location on an interactive map. Features position history and accuracy indicators using weighted averaging for enhanced precision.
imageAlt: Map interface showing GPS tracking visualization

title: Nearest Mount Point Finder
description: Find the nearest NTRIP mount point in the ASG-EUPOS network
imageAlt: Map showing NTRIP mount points in the ASG-EUPOS network

title: Reaction Time Test
description: A web-based application to measure and track your reaction time. Test your reflexes and compare results with previous attempts.
imageAlt: Reaction time test interface with results display

title: Blind Test
description: A web application designed to facilitate unbiased product testing by implementing a double-blind methodology.
imageAlt: Blind test application interface for product testing

title: Color Matcher
description: A tool that helps you find the closest matching named colors from CSS and Material Design palettes for any color input. Supports various color formats including hex, RGB, and color names.
imageAlt: Color matching tool showing color swatches and palettes
